entities.summary: Wilfred Kanu Jr., known by his stage name Freddy Will, is a Sierra Leonean American author, music producer, publisher, recording artist, and philanthropist best known for releasing three consecutive albums with accompanying books. He launched his music career by mixing hip-hop with jazz, calypso, r&b, classical music, and Afrobeat. He writes books on history, philosophy, biography, poetry, personal development, and fiction. He is best known for his singles "City Boy" (2008), "Providence feat. Carvin Winans" (2009), "Endurance" (2010), "Mandingo Love" (2012), "2 Passports" (2014), "Livin' N' Toronto feat.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Freddy Will's music career and literary works have had a significant impact on West African American culture, particularly in the realms of hip-hop and R&B. His albums and singles have been commercially successful, with 'City Boy' reaching over 100,000 streams on platforms like Spotify.
